title: Newmark Arranges $30 Million Sale of Block 37, a Trophy Retail Asset in Downtown Chicago
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $30 million sale of Block 37, a 277,654-square-foot trophy retail asset in the heart of downtown Chicago.
